short: Kazakhstan's Law "On Artificial Intelligence" No. 230-VIII, signed in November 2025, entered into force sixty days after its first publication on 18 November 2025; violations bring liability under other laws, so the law itself states no fine.
title: Kazakhstan AI Laws
subtitle: The Law "On Artificial Intelligence" No. 230-VIII of 17 November 2025
body_html:
Status at a glance

Binding AI law in force. Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 230-VIII "On Artificial Intelligence" was adopted on 17 November 2025 and signed by President K. Tokayev; its state register number is 217048. It was first published on 18 November 2025, in Egemen Kazakhstan No. 222 and Kazakhstanskaya Pravda No. 222, and entered into force sixty calendar days after that publication (Art. 31), which counts to 18 January 2026. It was amended by Law No. 326-VIII of 24 June 2026. Verified on 13 November 2026 against Adilet, the official legal database.

Key instruments

Who regulates and enforces

Liability for violations arises under the other laws of Kazakhstan (Art. 30), so enforcement follows those laws.

Scope and reach

The law governs artificial intelligence in the Republic of Kazakhstan. Its in-force date is not written in the law as a date: Art. 31 sets it at sixty calendar days after first official publication, and 18 January 2026 is that count from 18 November 2025.
